notes: Both CT controlled-pleading tracks are genuine custom pleadings: the registry records no official form for either, and the Clean Slate portal is the recorded authority for the no-official-form finding on § 54-142v.

No proposed order and no certificate of service is drafted on either track. On ct-cannabis-petition a proposed order is described as recommended but no form exists and clerk acceptance is unconfirmed; on ct-decriminalized no source mentions one at all.

ct-decriminalized carries three open legal-design build blockers. They govern whether and what to file, so the container is drafted and the blockers are flagged; no fee, eligibility or filing-practice statement is asserted.

The committed Connecticut state pack holds build metadata and the Nationwide inventory only. The compiled CT profile does not mention § 54-142d at all, and describes cannabis erasure only as the automatic § 21a-279(c) lane — not the § 54-142v petition. Both tracks therefore rest primarily on the pinned registry entries.
